pages.text: The $(item)Ritual Circle$() performs advanced pattern-based rituals.$(br2)Arrange $(item)Ritual Pedestals$() around the circle in one of the defined $(l)patterns$(), then place the required ingredients on them.$(br2)Right-click the circle to begin - if the pedestal layout and items match a recipe, the ritual starts and consumes $(mana)mana$().

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)Right-click while active to check $(l)progress$() and stored mana$(li)If no recipe matches, $(l)Shift + Right-click$() shows debug info about detected patterns (when enabled in config)$(li)Supply mana via $(item)Moonlight Focus$() links or adjacent mana sources$(br2)Craft powerful items such as the $(item)Moonlight Focus$() and $(item)Celestial Enchanting Table$() here.
